title: MapleStory Classic Bowman Build and Leveling Guide: Lv 1-30
intro: Bowmen train under Athena Pierce in Henesys. They shoot arrows from a very long range, keep mobs out of their face with bow whack, and have the highest accuracy in the game.

blocks.p: **Pros**

ul: Furthest attack range in the game, extended by up to 120 px with The Eye of Amazon.
DEX and character level give Bowmen huge Accuracy. Focus adds even more.
Critical Shot gives 20% Critical Rate and 15% Critical Damage.

blocks.p: **Cons**

ul: Limited mobbing before second job. Double Shot can hit two mobs, but splits its damage between them.
Bow whacking replaces ranged attacks when a mob gets too close.

blocks.p: Understanding Accuracy is the core of any class guide and training recommendation. A miss still consumes MP and an arrow.

blocks.h2: Levels 10-30: Bowman skill build and leveling

blocks.p: The main SP order raises Arrow Blow while taking one point in Eye at level 12 and reaching Eye 3 at level 15. That gives you +60 px range early, maxes Arrow Blow at level 18, and catches the pure damage-first order at level 23. At level 30, one point goes into Power Knockback for close-range utility.

**Pick Henesys citizenship.** Sign with Arthur in Henesys Town Hall. Raymond sells Supreme Sniper Potion for +7 Accuracy. Bronze Arrows for 2 mesos each unlock at Helpful Stranger, grade 3, which needs level 22 and 2,000 citizenship contribution. Later grades add Overall Armor DEX and Gloves Attack scrolls.

Both attacks reach 240% total damage at max skill level and use your equipped weapon's shooting speed. Arrow Blow puts it all into one hit. Double Shot fires two 120% arrows with lower damage variance, giving more stable total damage when both hit the same mob. Both are projectiles, and terrain can block either one.

This guide maxes Arrow Blow for its lower MP and arrow cost, longer range, and better Knockback potential. Its larger single hit can reach a mob's Knockback threshold when either of Double Shot's smaller hits falls short.

Against a group, Double Shot can hit two mobs once each instead of hitting one mob twice. Some players like spreading the damage; others prefer to focus on one mob. If the first arrow kills a mob, the second arrow can travel to another target instead of being wasted as overkill.
Double Shot can pull another mob toward you before you've finished the first. On a small platform, that extra aggro can leave you with less room to shoot.

It becomes more MP-efficient when each arrow kills a separate mob: two kills for 16 MP, or 8 MP per kill, compared with Arrow Blow's 14 MP per kill. This can be useful when farming weaker mobs for drops.

It also reaches 50 px less far. Its split targeting can be useful or frustrating, depending on whether you want to hit two mobs or finish one.

blocks.p: Second-job SP cannot be spent on first-job skills, so finish the first-job plan by level 30. Character Builder flags any build that breaks it.
**Getting crowded before level 30?** Take one point in Power Knockback at level 11. You give up a little early damage to unlock the push sooner. Arrow Blow still reaches max level at 18.

blocks.h3: Why take Eye of Amazon early?

blocks.p: A pure damage-first order deals more damage per cast until level 23. This guide gives up a small amount of early damage for longer range and better MP efficiency at the level 15 checkpoint.

This guide: +60 px range and 13.5% more damage per MP. Damage first: +5.7% expected damage and DPS.
This guide: +60 px range. Damage first: +1.4% expected damage and DPS.
The builds are identical from here.

blocks.note: **Want pure damage first?** Kiwi's community Bowman guide maxes Arrow Blow, Critical Shot, then Eye. This guide's early-Eye order reaches the same AB 20 / CS 15 / EYE 5 result at level 23.

blocks.p: After becoming a Hunter, put the new second-job point into Arrow Bomb. Once Arrow Bomb can replace Arrow Blow on the mobs you are farming, an SP Reset Coupon can move the first-job points into utility. One max-utility result is **CS 15 / EYE 15 / FOC 20 / PKB 11**. Power Knockback 11 deals 155% damage to up to three mobs, pushes them 140 px, and costs 9 MP.
Crossbowmen should check Iron Arrow before removing Arrow Blow. The launch price of an SP Reset Coupon is not confirmed.

Equipment depends on what you find and can afford. The table below uses the current bow and crossbow requirements. DEX is the main damage stat. STR is the secondary stat for Bowman weapon requirements and damage.
Equipment stats can meet a requirement. The stats on the weapon itself cannot help equip that weapon.
Pick whichever weapon you get for free from mob drops. Bows attack faster but have less WATK. Crossbows require less STR, hit harder per arrow so more DMG/MP efficient, but attacks slower.
In this Arrow Blow comparison, the bow deals about 3.5% more DPS. The crossbow deals about 5.2% more damage per cast and 5.2% more damage per MP.

Karl sells the level 10-30 bows and crossbows in Henesys. Sam sells the hats and body armor shown below. The gloves are Leatherworking crafts at skill Lv 3, 4, 5, and 6. Shop gear is enough for these checkpoints, so do not burn your mesos chasing tiny early upgrades in the Free Market.
Plain arrows cost 1 meso each and stack to 1,000. Raymond's Bronze arrows cost 2 mesos each, stack to 800, and add 1 W.ATK. Arrow Blow consumes one arrow per cast; Double Shot consumes two.

blocks.h3: W.ATK or Critical Rate on gloves?

blocks.p: This comparison uses the level 30 bow build and five successful Lesser glove scrolls. Both options fill the Green Marker's five slots.

**+5 W.ATK**
Expected Arrow Blow damage rises from 427 to 469, a 9.8% gain.

**+5% Critical Rate**
Expected Arrow Blow damage rises from 427 to 434, a 1.6% gain.

blocks.note: **Use Gloves Attack Scrolls.** The Attack setup deals about 8.1% more expected damage than the Critical Rate setup. W.ATK also raises the weakest non-critical hit, which helps guaranteed kills.

blocks.p: Bowmen do not get a class overall by level 30. Every Bowman can equip a [[img:ce6353bc3a96de.png]]Blue Sauna Robe or [[img:28e63130664b1b.png]]Red Sauna Robe at level 30. Both start with +1 to every AP stat and 10 upgrade slots.

Lesser Overall DEX scrolls add +1 DEX at 100%. Intermediate scrolls add +2 DEX at 60%. Tops and bottoms do not have STR, DEX, INT, or LUK scrolls, so a scrolled Sauna Robe can become the better damage piece.

NiaMeowDB's Training Advisor uses the sample's damage, Accuracy, HP, defense, mob spawns, and attack timing. Every listed target has a 100% hit rate, and every spawn dies within two Arrow Blows using the weakest possible damage.

**What does weakest damage mean?** Your damage changes from attack to attack. This is the lowest normal hit the build can deal. A guaranteed 2-cast kill still works when both attacks roll that low value.

Danger is included in the ranking. Ranged classes receive a smaller danger penalty than melee classes, but an unsafe map still loses score. The refill column starts from the map's nearest town because a nearest-town scroll only handles the trip back to town.
**Give yourself room to shoot.** Fast moving mobs and small platforms can make you bow whack often.
If you spend more time backing away than shooting, try a platform with more room or slower mobs. A lower-level map can work better for you if you can shoot consistently.

ol: **Adding STR for first-job advancement.** There is no stat requirement. Add STR only when the next weapon needs it.
**Following bow STR requirements on a crossbow build.** Crossbows need less STR. Put the saved AP into DEX.

**Standing inside bow whack range.** Use platforms and Eye's extra range to keep space. Your bow whacks at close range by design, and Power Knockback is a first-job skill for pushing mobs back out of it.

**Assuming Double Shot deals more single-target damage.** Both attacks reach 240% total damage at max skill Lv. Double Shot has more stable damage when both arrows hit one mob, but it can split its hits across two mobs. Arrow Blow costs less MP and one fewer arrow, with better Knockback potential.
**Running out of arrows. You become chopped liver when you got no ammo.**
**Building Critical Rate with scrolls.** W.ATK is much better than Crit Rate and wins the level 30 comparison.

blocks.h2: At level 30: choose your second job

ol: Start the second-job advancement with Athena Pierce in Henesys.
Take Athena's letter to the Bowman Job Instructor at The Road to the Dungeon.
Kill the test mobs until you have 30 Dark Marbles, then exchange them for The Proof of a Hero.
Return to Athena Pierce and choose Hunter or Crossbowman.

blocks.p: Uses bows. Bow Mastery adds Evasion, Bow Booster raises attack speed, and Arrow Bomb attacks groups of mobs and can stun them.
Uses crossbows. Crossbow Mastery can ignore WDEF, and Iron Arrow pierces a horizontal line.
